services.desc: Experience some of the best fishing Galveston has to offer! 6 Hours About These trips are typically a mix of bay or jetty fishing and fishing along the Galveston beachfront as well as nearshore waters. Depending on the weather and conditions, we may focus on the jetties or be fishing at rigs or bottom structure a little further offshore. We try to focus on the fish that are biting, instead of chasing the ones that aren't. extraNote: Feel free to call or text if you need to cancel, or reschedule your trip at any time. · Due to last minute cancellations and no show bookings, we strictly follow this refund and cancellation policy for all trips: 14 calendar days or more in advance of the scheduled trip date, you are eligible and will receive a 100% refund. · 7 calendar days or more in advance of the scheduled trip date, you are eligible and will receive a 75% refund. · 3 calendar days or more in advance of the scheduled trip date, you are eligible and will receive a 50% refund. · Any cancellations less than 3 calendar days in advance of the scheduled trip date, you will receive NO REFUND. · All no show trips on the schedule
checkin: Know Before You Go Keep in mind that a deckhand's day extends well before and after your trip. Getting the boat ready, filleting fish and assisting you as needed along the way are just the highlights of his role on each trip. Gratuities of 15-25% are greatly appreciated. Anyone over the age over 16 must have a valid Texas Saltwater fishing license for any fishing trips.
cancellation: Feel free to call or text if you need to cancel, or reschedule your trip at any time. Due to last minute cancellations and no show bookings, we strictly follow this refund and cancellation policy for all trips: 14 calendar days or more in advance of the scheduled trip date, you are eligible and will receive a 100% refund.
policies: Feel free to call or text if you need to cancel, or reschedule your trip at any time.
7 calendar days or more in advance of the scheduled trip date, you are eligible and will receive a 75% refund.
3 calendar days or more in advance of the scheduled trip date, you are eligible and will receive a 50% refund.
Any cancellations less than 3 calendar days in advance of the scheduled trip date, you will receive NO REFUND.
All no show trips on the scheduled date of the trip, you will receive NO REFUND.
Any and all weather related cancellations are determined by the captain of the trip.
In the event of a weather cancellation, you will receive a 100% refund.
